chapter: New York, Dallas and Kansas City
title: Houston the night after Pearl Harbor
summary: In Houston, servicemen were ordered back to base and the club emptied.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Yes. We switched from there to Houston and I was there in Houston when the Japanese struck Pearl Harbor and I remember that day -- no, the following day that the whole City of Houston was populated by servicemen, soldiers, so that night when we went to work and it was almost midnight before we put the show on. And this officer who was in the service came up to the bandstand and said, 'Shut it down for a second, I wish to make an announcement, sir.' So he announced to the people in the nightclub that 'this is an emergency, would all servicemen report to their base,' and since it was mostly servicemen, the whole place emptied, you know. But it was the start of the War.
